title: upload png asset returns 200 with url and refcount zero
description: POST /api/assets/upload as admin (Authorization: Bearer test-testadmin) with multipart form field 'file' containing a small valid PNG (content-type image/png). Expect 200 with JSON containing id, url (http...), mime image/png, size_bytes > 0, original_name and refcount 0. Then GET the returned url without auth and expect 200 with the same bytes.

title: upload svg rejected with 415
description: POST /api/assets/upload as admin with multipart 'file' declaring content-type image/svg+xml. Expect HTTP 415 (SVG is excluded from the MIME whitelist by design). Also try content-type application/x-msdownload and expect 415.

title: upload larger than 10MB rejected with 413
description: POST /api/assets/upload as admin with a file of 10*1024*1024+1 bytes (content-type image/png). Expect HTTP 413. Assert on status code only (error messages are in Portuguese).

title: master forbidden on media endpoints
description: Using Authorization: Bearer test-puczaras (master role): POST /api/assets/upload with a small png expects 403; GET /api/assets expects 403; POST /api/assets/gc expects 403.

title: list assets returns paginated workspace library
description: As admin (Bearer test-testadmin), upload one small png, then GET /api/assets. Expect 200 with shape {data: [...], total: n, limit, offset} where data contains the uploaded asset (matching id) with refcount 0 and total >= 1.

title: create table data_type whitelist and reserved name
description: As admin: (a) POST /tables/ with a UNIQUE random table name (suffix timestamp) and columns [{name:'titulo', data_type:'String'}, {name:'foto', data_type:'image'}] expects 200 and response includes the columns; (b) POST /tables/ with another unique name and a column data_type 'NotAType' expects 422; (c) POST /tables/ with name 'assets' expects 400 (reserved). Assert status codes only.

title: refcount increments on insert and swaps on update
description: As admin: upload two png assets A and B (note their id and url). Create a table with UNIQUE random name and columns [{name:'titulo', data_type:'String'}, {name:'foto', data_type:'image'}]. POST /api/{table} with {titulo:'p1', foto: <A.url>} expects 200. GET /api/assets and verify asset A refcount == 1. PUT /api/{table}/{record_id} with {foto: <B.url>} expects 200; verify A refcount == 0 and B refcount == 1. PUT with only {titulo:'renamed'} (no foto key) keeps B refcount == 1.

title: delete asset referenced returns 409 then 200 when free
description: As admin: upload asset C, create table with UNIQUE random name and an image column, insert a record referencing C.url. DELETE /api/assets/{C.id} expects 409. DELETE /api/{table}/{record_id} expects 200 (refcount back to 0). DELETE /api/assets/{C.id} now expects 200. GET /api/assets no longer lists C.

title: gc does not collect fresh uploads
description: As admin: upload a fresh png asset, then POST /api/assets/gc. Expect 200 with {removed: 0} because orphans are only collected after 24h minimum age. The fresh asset must still be present in GET /api/assets.

title: delete table decrements refcounts of referenced assets
description: As admin: upload asset D, create table with UNIQUE random name and an image column, insert a record referencing D.url (D refcount becomes 1). DELETE /tables/{table_id}?confirm_name=<exact table name> expects 200. GET /api/assets and verify D refcount == 0. Also verify DELETE /tables/{table_id} with wrong confirm_name on another fresh table returns 400.

title: external url in media column is ignored
description: As admin: create table with UNIQUE random name and an image column. POST a record with foto = 'https://i.imgur.com/external.png'. Expect 200 (no error). GET /api/assets and verify NO asset refcount changed (managed assets unaffected by external URLs).

title: add column to existing table honors whitelist
description: As admin: create a table with UNIQUE random name and one String column. POST /tables/{table_id}/columns with {name:'anexo', data_type:'attachment', is_nullable:true} expects 200. POST /tables/{table_id}/columns with {name:'bad', data_type:'blob'} expects 422.
